d:
Payaliya – Let the rhythm of love echo with every step.
Experience the timeless charm of "Payaliya", a soulful melody that beautifully captures the emotions of love, longing, and togetherness. With enchanting vocals, heartfelt lyrics, and a mesmerizing composition, this song is sure to stay with you long after it ends.
Song : Payaliya
Singer : Kumar Sanu & Alka Yagnik
Music : Nadeem- Shravan
Lyrics : Sameer
Producer : Guddu Dhanoa,Lalit Kapoor,Raju Kothari,K K Nayyar
Director : Raj Kanwar
